{{Conjecture}}
A '''bar''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Ribba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] put out a bounty on an [[Unidentified embezzler|individual]], who fled to Celanon. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] tracked the embezzler to the bar, where a [[Bar fight on Celanon|firefight]] broke out, resulting the the embezzler's [[Death/Legends|death]].
